name: kinetic-type
title: Kinetic type
summary: A 10-to-60-second film where the voice's words are the picture: phrases set in the brand's type, each landing on the word that says it.
use_when: The message is the words: a manifesto, a quote, a sharp claim, or a film with nothing else to show.

beats.name: statement
beats.job: The first line, set big, landing on its own word.

beats.name: build
beats.job: Phrases that build the argument, the rhythm carried by type and cuts.

beats.name: landing
beats.job: The line to remember, held, then the lockup.

rules: Each phrase lands on its spoken word (the Whisper word timings); nothing arrives early.
Phrases, not paragraphs: three to six words on screen at a time.
Per-character motion only for hero words (the kit caps it).
A phrase that stays up still meets the read-time rule.
The words on screen match the voice exactly, so they double as captions.

captions.note: The type on screen carries every spoken word, so nothing else is burned in; sidecar files serve players.

budget.note: Generation is rarely useful here: the type is the picture.
